wall_segment.name: Wall Segment
wall_segment.appearance: A sturdy wall segment designed to provide robust defense against enemy attacks. It features a reinforced steel frame with thick armor plating, offering high durability and resistance to damage. The wall segment is equipped with a small turret on top, allowing it to engage enemies while providing cover for friendly units behind it.

gate_segment.name: Gate Segment
gate_segment.appearance: A sturdy gate segment designed to provide controlled access while maintaining defensive integrity. It features a reinforced steel frame with thick armor plating, offering high durability and resistance to damage. The gate segment is equipped with a small turret on top, allowing it to engage enemies while providing cover for friendly units behind it.

guard_tower.name: Guard Tower
guard_tower.appearance: A tall guard tower designed to provide elevated observation and defensive capabilities. It features a reinforced steel frame with thick armor plating, offering high durability and resistance to damage. The tower is equipped with a large turret on top, allowing it to engage enemies at long range while providing cover for friendly units behind it.

light_turret_mk1.name: Light Turret Mk1
light_turret_mk1.appearance: A compact gimbaled turret mounted on a reinforced steel base with clean lines, a single barrel, and a utilitarian gray finish accented by subtle green highlights.

light_turret_mk2.name: Light Turret Mk2
light_turret_mk2.appearance: An updated gimbaled turret with a dual-barrel layout, a more robust housing, and a darker gray finish with blue accent strips.

medium_turret_mk1.name: Medium Turret Mk1
medium_turret_mk1.appearance: A medium-duty turret with a balanced dual-barrel silhouette, moderate armor plating, and dark gray bodywork with blue trim.

medium_turret_mk2.name: Medium Turret Mk2
medium_turret_mk2.appearance: A beefier medium turret with a quad-barrel head, reinforced armor plating, and darker gray surfaces trimmed in red.

heavy_turret_mk1.name: Heavy Turret Mk1
heavy_turret_mk1.appearance: A heavy-duty turret with a quad-barrel array, thick armor segments, and dark gray hull surfaces accented in red.

heavy_turret_mk2.name: Heavy Turret Mk2
heavy_turret_mk2.appearance: A reinforced heavy turret with a quad-barrel mount, layered armor panels, and a deep gray finish with red accent lines.

light_support_turret.name: Light Support Turret
light_support_turret.appearance: A compact support turret with a single barrel, sleek bodywork, and a light gray finish highlighted by green trim.

medium_support_turret.name: Medium Support Turret
medium_support_turret.appearance: A medium support turret with a dual-barrel profile, functional armor plating, and a dark gray finish with green highlights.

heavy_support_turret.name: Heavy Support Turret
heavy_support_turret.appearance: A heavy support turret with a quad-barrel tower, bulky armor plating, and a dark gray exterior accented by red details.
